area: Dubai Mall food court; also Al Quoz
name: Noon & Kabab
questions: Is the kebab mince bound with breadcrumbs?
Is any marinade made with soy or Maggi?
Is the rice cooked plain, with no vermicelli or bread tahdig?
Is the bread served on the same tray as the rice?

summary: Atly lists it as unverified, with one undated review claiming the menu is gluten-free and no menu marking; treat it as ask-first.
